missions.title: Migrate Dict[Any, Any] to Pydantic Models
missions.description: Replace all Dict[str, Any] with properly typed Pydantic models throughout the codebase for better type safety and validation. Focus on agency_code_agent, planner_agent, and shared modules.
missions.command: /primeA 'Migrate all Dict[str, Any] to Pydantic models in agency_code_agent/ and planner_agent/ modules'

missions.title: Generate API Reference Documentation
missions.description: Auto-generate comprehensive API reference documentation for all public agent interfaces, tools, and shared modules. Include usage examples and constitutional compliance notes.
missions.command: /primeA 'Generate API reference docs for all agent public methods and tools'

missions.title: Improve Test Coverage to 95%+
missions.description: Identify untested code paths and add comprehensive tests following NECESSARY pattern (Normal, Edge, Security, Spec, Accessibility, Resilience, Year-round). Focus on areas with <80% coverage.
missions.command: /primeA 'Add tests for uncovered code paths in agency_code_agent/ to reach 95% coverage'

missions.title: Refactor Functions Over 50 Lines
missions.description: Find and refactor all functions exceeding 50 lines into focused, single-purpose functions following constitutional standards (Article II). Maintain 100% test pass rate.
missions.command: /primeA 'Refactor all functions over 50 lines in scripts/ directory into smaller focused functions'

missions.title: Update ADR Index and Cross-References
missions.description: Review all ADRs for completeness, update ADR-INDEX.md with new decisions, and add cross-references between related ADRs. Ensure all specs reference appropriate ADRs.
missions.command: /primeA 'Update ADR-INDEX.md and add cross-references between related ADRs'

missions.title: Audit and Improve Docstrings
missions.description: Ensure all public functions, classes, and modules have comprehensive docstrings with usage examples. Focus on agent definitions and tools.
missions.command: /primeA 'Add comprehensive docstrings to all public functions in tools/ directory'

missions.title: Remove Dead Code and Unused Imports
missions.description: Identify and safely remove unused imports, functions, and variables. Verify with full test suite before committing. Use /prune command for safe deletion.
missions.command: /primeA 'Use /prune --scope all to remove unused code across codebase'

missions.title: Run Constitutional Compliance Audit
missions.description: Audit entire codebase for constitutional compliance violations (Articles I-V). Generate report with auto-fix suggestions for confidence ≥ 0.9 patterns.

missions.title: Sync Learnings to VectorStore
missions.description: Extract patterns from recent session logs and sync to VectorStore for institutional memory (Article IV compliance). Minimum confidence: 0.6.

missions.title: Add Missing Type Hints
missions.description: Audit all Python files for missing type hints. Add proper type annotations for function parameters, return values, and class attributes. Run mypy validation.
missions.command: /primeA 'Add missing type hints to all functions in shared/ directory and validate with mypy'

missions.title: Expand Integration Test Suite
missions.description: Add integration tests for multi-agent workflows (scout → plan → build, audit → fix → verify). Validate end-to-end scenarios with Docker Compose.
missions.command: /primeA 'Add integration tests for /scout_plan_build workflow with Docker Ollama'

missions.title: Security Audit and Hardening
missions.description: Audit for security vulnerabilities: command injection, path traversal, unsafe file operations. Review tool security hardening (41 production tools).
missions.command: /primeA 'Audit all tools/ for security vulnerabilities and apply hardening patterns'
